findings.text: the autouse guard inventories the real home's lane-probe cache tree, but both crew_lanes_view call sites in this file inject a probe reader (tests/test_lanes_view_is_live.py:223 and :574), so no case here reaches the tree's only production writer (resumption.probe_lane_availability, called from reckon/budget.py:1626); the assertion therefore cannot fire on the reviewed code, and its realistic trigger is a concurrent session's own probe refresh, which it would report as a lanes-view case writing the real home - the race the sibling guard at tests/test_mcp_recovery.py:348-352 avoids by scoping to the case's own run id. Low severity: the repaired tree is the right one and the repair's positive control is the out-of-file demonstration. Remedy: scope the comparison to writes attributable to the case, or keep a sentinel writer in the fixture as a live positive control.

item_verdicts.done_when: ADDRESSED - re-ran the declared four-file gate at the reviewed head in an isolated worktree: 44 passed exit 0 (log /tmp/review-stale-requery/gate-head.log), and the added cases assert each outcome clause (probe wins for every lane on that account, a command declared by two pools still answers, a failed re-query keeps the old figure and its age, a receipt inside its shelf life is reported without a requery).
item_verdicts.goal: ADDRESSED - read plan section 5b's done-when against the merged diff at 93b848f8: crew_lanes_view re-queries a reading older than budget.evidence_shelf_life_minutes through the single pre-existing resolver staleness.resolve_configured_reading (no second resolver), the probe's figure is the one returned, and a failed re-query keeps the old figure with its age and a serving state of unknown under reason requery_did_not_answer.

justifications.durability: every added assertion names a change that would redden it (ownership gate reinstated reddens the pooled-lane case, an unconditional requery reddens the inside-shelf-life case, an undetected probe failure reddens the unknown-state case), though the home-untouched tripwire's only realistic in-file trigger is a concurrent peer write rather than the reviewed code.

justifications.fit: the lane dict gains the single field requeried at reckon/mcp_views.py:980 beside the probe's own figures, and the re-query goes through the pre-existing staleness module resolved at import time rather than through a new abstraction.
